column2: I check the average button has code, refuses letters, and shows 6 for 5, 6 and 7.
The average button starts with a bool called passValidation set to true. Any failed check turns it false.
If any of the three attempt boxes is empty, passValidation is set to false.
If the first attempt box holds something that is not a number from 0 to 9, passValidation is set to false.
The same letter check is done for the second and third attempt boxes.
If passValidation is false, a message asks for numbers only and the three boxes are emptied.
The three attempts are added, divided by 3, rounded to 2 places, kept in Global.cs and shown in the box.
Global.cs notes the average is worked out and keeps the three attempts. The attempts panel switches off.
After the attempts are kept, the quiz panel switches on so the pupil can move on.
I run the program and try letters, 5 6 7, 5 6 8, and typing in the grey attempts panel.
